title: In this town, your key opens one door, and it's never your own
description:
In this town, everyone is born with a key on a cord round their neck. It opens exactly one door, and it's never your own. I've tried mine in every lock in town, and it has never opened anything.

My great-aunt Win runs the windmill out on the marsh. Her mill has stood open day and night for thirty years. This week it was locked, and every night the flour on the floor stayed clean in one spot, a little closer behind her.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Whose front door do you think your key would open?
shape: a warm work scene at the millstones, then the first line said again with a new reading, ending cold on the clean patch by the hoist
